name: crew-pairing-set-covering-master
description: Set-covering / set-partitioning master problem of a column-generation crew-pairing scheduler for an airline. Each candidate column is a crew roster (an ordered sequence of duties: execution flights, positioning flights/buses, ground duties) generated by the pricing subproblem. The master selects at most one roster per crew so that every flight and every mandatory ground duty is covered, otherwise an explicit uncovered-slack variable is penalized. Solved as an LP relaxation each column-generation iteration to obtain duals (solve_lp), and finally as a binary integer program (solve_bip). Built incrementally: constraints are created empty at setup and re-formed as columns are added in _add_roster.

indices.name: F
indices.description: set of (execution) flights to be covered

indices.name: G
indices.description: set of mandatory ground duties (occupancy tasks) to be covered

indices.name: R
indices.description: set of generated rosters (columns); each roster r belongs to one crew

indices.name: R_f
indices.description: rosters that cover flight f by executing it (non-positioning)

indices.name: R_g
indices.description: rosters that cover ground duty g

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: cost of roster r = positioning_penalty + overnight_penalty + violation_penalty - flight_reward; flight_reward = FLIGHT_TIME_REWARD * roster_flight_hours / global_duty_days_denominator (global average daily flight-time approximation) [domain R]

parameters.name: P_G
parameters.description: penalty per uncovered ground duty (UNCOVERED_GROUND_DUTY_PENALTY) [domain R_>=0]

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: 1 if roster r executes (non-positioning) flight f, else 0; encoded implicitly via membership of v in flight f's covering_vars [domain {0,1}]

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: 1 if roster r covers ground duty g, else 0; encoded implicitly via membership of v in ground duty g's covering_vars [domain {0,1}]

variables.name: x
variables.description: 1 if roster r is selected (LP-relaxed to [0,1] in solve_lp; lb=0.1 protective lower bound for initial-solution columns)

variables.name: u
variables.description: 1 if flight f is left uncovered (slack), in [0,1]

variables.name: z
variables.description: 1 if ground duty g is left uncovered (slack), in [0,1]

constraints.name: crew_at_most_one_roster
constraints.description: each crew is assigned at most one roster (created empty at setup, rebuilt as columns are added)

constraints.name: flight_cover
constraints.description: each flight is executed by exactly one selected roster, or counted as uncovered (set-partitioning equality with slack; initialized as u_f = 1)

constraints.name: ground_duty_cover
constraints.description: each mandatory ground duty is covered by exactly one selected roster, or counted as uncovered (set-partitioning equality with slack; initialized as z_g = 1)

objective.name: objective
objective.description: minimize total selected-roster cost plus penalties for uncovered flights and uncovered ground duties (objective coefficients set directly via the obj= argument on each addVar; ModelSense = MINIMIZE)
